title: 检测不等于可靠控制：可解码的共情方向在自动化共情评分中仅产生部分偏移
summary: 该研究测试了可解码的“共情”方向是否可作为因果杠杆，在三个指令微调LLM上对EPITOME的认知和情感两个维度进行干预。结果显示，情感维度控制通过，但认知维度不一致；情感方向仅部分提升评分，认知方向无显著变化，但可能因测量工具不敏感。检测不等于可靠控制，认知共情主张需明确测量敏感性检查。
summary_en: This study tests whether decodable 'empathy' directions serve as causal levers, intervening on EPITOME's cognitive and affective facets in three instruction-tuned LLMs. Affective control passes, cognitive is inconsistent; affective steering partially raises scores, cognitive shows no measurable change possibly due to coarse instruments. Detection does not imply reliable control; cognitive claims need sensitivity checks.
